main.description: A physical-simulation digital-twin condition snapshot for one DEPLOYED lifeline asset (ADR-2606280900). A REAL degradation model per lifeline (transformer IEEE C57.91 thermal aging / water-main Hazen-Williams decline / gas-main corrosion→leak / fibre attenuation creep / road pavement PCI + bridge load-rating) computes condition (0..1) + remaining-useful-life + operating margin + structural safety. SIMULATION ONLY (G5) — the twin computes; it never energizes/flows/ignites/opens a road. A condition MAP, never a person record (G1).

asset.description: asset id (e.g. xfmr-midori-1); a piece of infrastructure, never a person (G1)

region.description: coarse region tag (aggregate; no per-asset precise location, G1)

condition.description: condition index ×1000 (fixed-point): 1000 = new, 0 = worn out, from the degradation model

opMargin.description: operating-envelope margin ×1000 (short-timescale 'holds load within the safe envelope')

safety.description: structural safety flag (gas leak-prob / bridge under-rating / insulation loss-of-life)

driver.description: the dominant degradation driver (e.g. θh=120°C FAA=2.71 / wall=3.4mm leak-p=0.91 / PCI=51)

sourcing.description: G8 — :synthetic at R0; real condition telemetry (kizashi sensing) is an operator/Council step
